329:t_2:53.en:
$$マオ$$
「We'll explain later! You go after $$クラマ$$!」

329:t_2:54.en:
$n
「$$宗介$$! He still owes us for what he did to $$常磐$$! Finish him off yourself!」

329:t_2:59.en:
$$クラマ$$
(...I never imagined the people from $c were here in $$ナムサク$$...)

329:t_2:60.en:
$$クラマ$$
(It was my mistake to use $$ファイヤバグ$$ to pursue them.)

329:t_2:61.en:
$$クラマ$$
(No, that's wrong... It was $$相良$$'s tenacity that ruined my plan.)

329:t_2:62.en:
$$クラマ$$
(I see why $$ガウルン$$ was so fond of him. He's... the same sort of man as me.)

329:t_2:65.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm going to finish you off with my own hands!」

329:t_2:66.en:
$$宗介$$
「And you're going to tell me where $$千鳥$$ is!!」

329:t_2:67.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Don't think you'll get your way! You're exhausted from all that fighting! What can you possibly do?!」

329:t_2:69.en:
$$クラマ$$
「It looks like you took two or three shots squarely. Now I'll take my time finishing you...」

329:t_2:71.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Im...possible... How can you... still move... after taking those bullets...?」

329:t_2:72.en:
$$宗介$$
「I... don't know either... I suppose... my anger... is driving me...」

329:t_2:73.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Hmph... I never thought... I'd hear... a sermon about willpower... now...」

329:t_2:74.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Tell... me, $$クラマ$$... Where... is $$千鳥$$?」

329:t_2:75.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Anger... my ass... It's... the power... of love...」

329:t_2:76.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Damn it... To think... something so stupid... would... do me...」

329:t_2:78.en:
$$クラマ$$
「$$サン・カルロス$$... If not there, $$ニケーロ$$ or... $$グラナダ$$...」

329:t_2:79.en:
$$クラマ$$
「...Tch... If I'd known... it'd end... like this... I never... would've... quit smok...」

329:t_2:80.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's not... over... The fighting... isn't over...!」

329:t_3:3.en: ～$$レナード・テスタロッサ$$　Hideout～

329:t_3:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I have nothing else to do.」

329:t_3:7.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「Wouldn't you like to change your clothes soon?」

329:t_3:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Sure, it's strange to keep wearing my school uniform, but it'll make it easier for him to find me.」

329:t_3:9.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「You still believe someone will come to rescue you...?」

329:t_3:10.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Of course I do. That's the kind of guy he is.」

329:t_3:11.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「You would do well to stop putting on a brave face.」

329:t_3:13.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「Then why do you look so sad?」

329:t_3:17.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I know that. I'm asking where he went and what he's doing.」

329:t_3:18.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You're his secretary. You must know, right?」

329:t_3:19.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「...I cannot give you details, but I understand he is meeting someone important.」

329:t_3:20.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Is it someone from $$サイデリアル$$...? Or $$クロノ$$?」

329:t_3:29.en:
$$レモン$$
「...Thank you for your cooperation, $$プリベンター・ウインド$$.」

329:t_3:30.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「No... Thanks to you, we minimized the damage to $$ナムサク$$ and reunited with our comrades.」

329:t_3:31.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Allow me to thank you as well, $$プリベンター・サンド$$.」

329:t_3:32.en:
$$レモン$$
「Haha... I never imagined I'd meet two senior $$プリベンター$$ officers, $$ウインド$$ and $$ファイヤー$$, in a place like this.」

329:t_3:33.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Were you also acting on $$レディ・アン$$'s orders?」

329:t_3:34.en:
$$レモン$$
「My main mission is to track $$アマルガム$$'s movements through channels separate from $$ミスリル$$.」

329:t_3:35.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「So you weren't coordinating with $$ミスリル$$?」

329:t_3:36.en:
$$レモン$$
「Commander $$レディ・アン$$ believed there was a high chance of an $$アマルガム$$ informant within $$ミスリル$$.」

329:t_3:37.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「So that's why the enemy knew the top-secret location of $$メリダ島$$...」

329:t_3:38.en:
$$レモン$$
「I came to $$ナムサク$$ to pick up $$アマルガム$$'s trail. I never expected to see them erase that trail instead.」

329:t_3:40.en:
$$レモン$$
「Are your wounds all right, $$宗介$$?」

329:t_3:42.en:
$$レモン$$
「You're a tough man. $$ナミ$$ was right to believe in you.」

329:t_3:44.en:
$$レモン$$
「...I approached $$チーム・クロスボウ$$ purely by chance.」

329:t_3:45.en:
$$レモン$$
「I thought if I slipped into a fairly strong team, the $$オーガ一家$$ would approach me, leading to information on $$アマルガム$$ behind them.」

329:t_3:47.en:
$$レモン$$
「I worked under a different jurisdiction from $c, so I didn't know about you either.」

329:t_3:48.en:
$$レモン$$
「But I knew a little about the $$ＡＲＸー７$$ equipped with a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$.」

329:t_3:49.en:
$$宗介$$
「You investigated me because I mentioned $$アーバレスト$$?」

329:t_3:50.en:
$$レモン$$
「That led me to $c, and the trouble in $$グルフェー$$ let me guide them here.」

329:t_3:52.en:
$$レモン$$
「I should thank you, $$宗介$$. Mission aside, I enjoyed the time I spent with you and $$ナミ$$.」

329:t_3:54.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But man, you sure went crazy, trying to take on $$アマルガム$$ all by yourself.」

329:t_3:55.en:
$$マオ$$
「He couldn't help it. Without proper communications, he probably never heard us calling him.」

329:t_3:56.en:
$$宗介$$
「Where did that $$アーバレスト$$ come from?」

329:t_3:57.en:
$$マオ$$
「I'm sure you already suspected it, but $$ミスリル$$ has effectively been wiped out.」

329:t_3:59.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But there are other survivors besides us. They're all still fighting their own battles.」

329:t_3:60.en:
$$クルツ$$
「And that AS is a gift from them to you.」
